SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. S. B. REGISTRY. / No. D 5792 / Date 8 / 7 / 35）
Date July 8, 1935.

Subject New owner of the "Astrid" Pharmacy.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by R. B. Seward. D.D.

Information has been received that Y. G. Hramchenko
(File I.O.5792), owner of the "Astrid" Pharmacy, No. 338,
Rue Cardinal Mercier, which was financed by the "Dalbank,"
severed his connections with that enterprise and that the
pharmacy at present is owned by his former partners O. L.
Dobrishman and A. Gulnik.
Particulars of the latter two individuals are as follows:
1) Osip Leonovitch Dobrishman is a Soviet citizen who was
born on 12.11.1894 at Odessa, South Russia, and is a
druggist by profession. He holds Soviet passport
No. 19169 issued on 30.6.26 at Harbin. Dobrishman arrived
in Shanghai from Harbin on 22.11.34 in the s.s. "Tsingtao
Maru." He resides with his wife Mrs. M.K. Dobrishman,
37, at House 1, No. 698, Rue Bourgeat, owned by I. Kotovitch,
brother of Leo Kotovitch (File D. 5151).
2) Alexander Gulnik is a Russian Jew who, it is reported,
recently renounced his Soviet citizenship and obtained
an emigrants' passport. His wife is still a Soviet
citizen.
Both O. L. Dobrishman and A. Gulnik are reported to be
on friendly terms with various Soviet agents.
The "Astrid" Pharmacy is patronized by local Soviet
citizens and, it is said, is used as a meeting place by
Soviet informers and sympathizers.

（签名：J. L. Goff） （签名：G. Tcheremshansky / D. S.）
8 JULY 1935
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特科第二股。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 S. B. REGISTRY. / 编号 D 5792 / 日期 8 / 7 / 35）
日期：1935年7月8日。

主题：“阿斯特丽德”药房的新业主。

制作人：D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人：R. B. Seward，副总监。

接获情报称，“阿斯特丽德”药房（位于麦神父路338号）的业主 Y. G. Hramchenko（档案号 I.O.5792），该药房由“远东银行”（Dalbank）提供资金，已切断与该企业的联系，目前该药房由其前合伙人 O. L. Dobrishman 和 A. Gulnik 所有。
后两人的具体情况如下：
1) Osip Leonovitch Dobrishman 是苏联公民，1894年11月12日出生于南俄敖德萨，职业为药剂师。他持有1926年6月30日在哈尔滨签发的苏联护照，号码为19169。Dobrishman 于1934年11月22日乘坐“青岛丸”轮从哈尔滨抵达上海。他与妻子 M.K. Dobrishman 夫人（37岁）居住在蒲石路698号1号房屋，该房产归 I. Kotovitch 所有，I. Kotovitch 系 Leo Kotovitch（档案号 D. 5151）之兄。
2) Alexander Gulnik 是一名俄国犹太人，据报最近已放弃苏联国籍并取得流亡者护照。其妻子仍为苏联公民。
据报，O. L. Dobrishman 和 A. Gulnik 均与各类苏联特工保持友好关系。
“阿斯特丽德”药房受到当地苏联公民的光顾，据说被用作苏联线人和同情者的聚会场所。

（签名：J. L. Goff） （签名：G. Tcheremshansky / D. S.）
1935年7月8日
副总监（特科）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date April 10. 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. 5792
Date 10 - 4 - 34）

Subject (in full) Pharmacy owned by Y. G. Hramchenko, ex Soviet Employee.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [签名]

Yakov Grigorievitch Hramchenko, former employee of the
United Petroleum Trust of the U.S.S.R. in Shanghai, who was
discharged in September 1933, during February 1934 opened a
pharmacy under the name "Astrid Pharmacy" at No. 338 Route
Cardinal Mercier, telephone No. 75178. It is said that he
is financed by the Far Eastern Bank. (Dalbank).

[签名: G Tcheremshansky]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（左侧批注：
x
Reasons unknown.
DMR.

报告
日期：1934年4月10日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. & S. B. 登记处。
档案号 5792
日期 10 - 4 - 34）

主题（全称）：前苏联雇员 Y. G. Hramchenko 所有的药房。

制作人：D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人：[签名]

Yakov Grigorievitch Hramchenko，前苏联驻上海联合石油信托公司员工，于1933年9月被解雇，于1934年2月在麦神父路338号开设了一家名为“阿斯特丽德药房”的药店，电话号码75178。据悉，其资金由远东银行（Dalbank）提供。

[签名: G Tcheremshansky]
D. S.

特科主管警官。

（左侧批注：
x
原因不明。
DMR.
